name: ReliefWeb reports
access_method: ReliefWeb API v2 (requires a pre-approved appname)
license: Varies by publishing organisation; see each report
terms_note: ReliefWeb requires API users to request an approved appname.
status_message: set EW_RELIEFWEB_APPNAME to an appname approved by ReliefWeb

name: GDELT DOC 2.0 news search
terms_note: Article titles and links only; publishers retain rights to article content.
status_message: 107 articles; errors: swahili: rate limited (HTTP 429) after 4 attempts; arabic: rate limited (HTTP 429) after 4 attempts

name: Operator-configured local news and radio feeds
status_message: set EW_RSS_FEEDS to a comma-separated list of lawful public RSS/Atom feeds

name: ProMED
status_message: ProMED content requires a subscription; set EW_PROMED_FEED_URL to a feed your organisation is licensed to use

name: Africa CDC news and epidemic intelligence
institution: Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention

name: ECDC outbreak update
institution: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control
access_method: public web page, updated every weekday (HTML)
license: © ECDC, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figures are extracted from the page text and reformatted as data.
terms_note: Only the situation summary is stored, with a link to the page; statements the page attributes to media reports are not extracted.

name: WHO Disease Outbreak News
license: © WHO. Reproduced extracts with attribution for non-commercial public-health use.
terms_note: Only short supporting quotes and extracted figures are stored, with links to the original bulletin.

name: HDX: DRC Ebola cases and deaths (national and health-zone)
institution: OCHA DRC / COUSP-RDC; transcription by INRB-UMIE
license: CC BY 4.0 (HDX); upstream repository MIT with a pre-publication contact request
terms_note: Upstream data producers (INRB/INSP) request contact before using the epidemiological data prior to their publication. Enable only after reviewing and honouring that request.
status_message: data-use conditions apply; review docs/DATA_SOURCES.md and add 'hdx_cod_ebola' to EW_SOURCE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS to enable

name: Official statements (transcribed)
access_method: statements by ministries of health and WHO offices, transcribed into data/official/statements.yaml
license: Figures and short quotes from the cited statements, with links; see each entry.
terms_note: Each entry names the authority, links to the statement and quotes it; corrections are added as new entries.

name: OpenStreetMap (Overpass API) infrastructure checks
terms_note: Attribution required: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Queries are small and rate-limited per the Overpass usage policy.

name: World Bank World Development Indicators: total population (SP.POP.TOTL)
Facebook public content
status_message: No general-purpose public-content search API is available (CrowdTangle was discontinued in 2024; the Meta Content Library requires approved research access) and automated scraping is prohibited by Meta's terms. Organisations with approved Content Library access can import aggregated exports through the manual import path.

name: Reddit public posts
terms_note: Requires a registered API client; public posts only.
status_message: set EW_REDDIT_CLIENT_ID and EW_REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET for a registered Reddit API client

name: Telegram public channels
status_message: The Bot API cannot read channels unless the bot is added by the channel owner, and the client API requires logging in as an individual user account; neither is used for unattended monitoring. Channel administrators who wish to contribute can share exports through the manual import path.

name: X (Twitter) public posts
access_method: X API v2 recent search (bearer token; paid access tier)
status_message: set EW_X_BEARER_TOKEN (X API access tier with recent search)

name: YouTube public videos (titles and descriptions)
terms_note: Metadata only; no video download or transcription.
